Spinner Varun Chakravarthy Out of Afghanistan Series Due to Injury

Indian cricketer Varun Chakravarthy has been ruled out of the upcoming T20 series against Afghanistan due to an injury. He sustained the injury after playing the first T20 match at Delhi's Arun Jaitley Stadium and will miss the remaining games of the series. This development is considered a significant setback for the Indian team.
